Definition: probably akin to G3588, G3739, and G3745; such or what sort of (as a correlation or exclamation); especially the neuter (adverbially) with negative, not so:--so (as), such as, what (manner of), which.
BiblicalUsage: The word hoîos is so (as), such as, what (manner of), which — a small word, used 11 times; Matthew and Mark show it in use.
TheologicalSignificance: I read hoîos plainly: so (as), such as, what (manner of), which, and I leave it there.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
